description_en: Queries a list of file versions
description_zh: 调用ListFileVersions查询文件的版本列表
name: ListFileVersions

parameters.help_en: The file ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html to query the file ID
parameters.help_zh:
文件的ID，
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html查询对应文件的ID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. To find this, click the wrench icon in the upper-right corner and navigate to the workspace management page
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID，
您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace, which is the identifier at the top of the Data Studio page where you switch workspaces.

Either this parameter or ProjectId must be specified to identify the target DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。


该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_zh:
请求的数据页数，
用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的条数，默认为10条，
最大100条
parameters.name: page_size
